Crypto++ 8.x ships a port of part of this code, so about 8 (x64) to 11 (x86) of these functions also match data/cryptopp under its C++ names; libsodium shares none. Upstream's own ed25519-hash-custom.h is an empty comment, so nothing in the upstream tree is changed.
